deployment: Recreate in the supported designer, bind approved end-user connections, map the publisher/table fields, and replace placeholders. These are not solution imports or a supported unattended deployment API.
placeholders: NORMAL_SOURCE_RECORD_ID is an operator-selected intake row. DENIED_ROW_ID is the all-zero GUID, which must not refer to a real row. Seed message IDs come from received-item selection. Keep fixed resources and allow-lists; never replace them with unconstrained model inputs.
limitations: Current reader/generator allow one source record. Integer-cent finance checks cover the documented synthetic English AUD format. Unsupported generator branch and partial/concurrent-write coverage remain incomplete; do not use for production or approve payments.
